inShort: A tosses six balls in quick succession, and B drives each one out of the air as fast as possible with a short backswing, ready again at once.
rules: A stands a few steps away and tosses 6 balls quickly, one after the other. B takes them out of the air.
B drives every ball as fast as possible and is ready for the next one at once.
No big backswing: the power comes from a short, quick swing forward.
After 6 balls, a short break. After 3 sets, swap roles.
tooEasy: 4 of 6 balls have to land in the court. Even harder: A varies the tempo, so B can't tell when the next ball comes.
tooHard: A tosses at a calm rhythm, and B thinks only about the short swing.
goodLooksLike: The backswing stays short, the ball still flies deep into the court, and B's paddle is back in front before the next toss.
